Questions

Good to know before you ask.

What does foreign used mean?

A foreign-used vehicle, often called tokunbo, was first registered and driven abroad before it was imported to Nigeria. Every listing shows its year, mileage and condition.

Are the listed prices final?

Prices are shown in Naira. Final terms are confirmed when you speak to our team, because availability and specification can change.

Can I test drive a vehicle first?

Yes. Choose a vehicle, a day and a time window, and we will confirm by WhatsApp or phone.

How does a vehicle swap work?

Tell us about the vehicle you own and the one you would like. We assess your vehicle, and any valuation, inspection, eligibility and final arrangement are subject to dealership assessment.

What is the fastest way to reach you?

WhatsApp. You can also call or email, and we reply during business hours.
